review.sendBody: The offers you prepare go to {partner} first: the company reviews, may change them, and sends them to the secretary. The secretary sees nothing until then.
review.reviewingBody: Prepared by {who} ({when}). The secretary does not see these offers yet: review, change if needed, and send.
review.waitingTitle: Sent to the company for review
review.waitingBody: {partner} reviews and sends to the secretary. You can keep correcting the offers meanwhile.
review.sendCta: Send to the company for review

errors.masterMustReview: In another company's ministry request the offers go to the company for review: use “Send to the company for review”.
errors.notMaster: Only the master sends offers to the company for review, and only in another company's ministry request.
errors.noOffers: Choose at least one offer to send.
errors.notDraft: The proposal is no longer a draft.

issue.waitPassengers: Ministry request: it is issued once the secretary chooses the option and registers the passengers (no payment on the platform).
issue.operatorOnlyNote: Ministry requests are issued by WeeFly.

errors.notReady: The ministry request is not ready to issue yet: the option or the passengers are missing.
errors.noSecretaryEmail: No active secretary of the ministry has an email: the tickets are in the ministry space.
